prompt: A local automation tool to generate my monthly invoice PDF from a Numbers template and send it by email — not a mobile/web app, no UI screens.

spec.name: invoicer
spec.description: Playwright-driven automation for the monthly Glassdoor invoice — generate the PDF, log time in Svitla, and email it — now also runs as a standing local HTTP API (server.js, openapi.yaml) instead of only through the /invoice slash command. No web/Android/iOS build applies to this kind of tool.

_note: Metadata reconstructed manually on 2026-08-10; server.js/openapi.yaml added 2026-08-10 to expose the same steps over HTTP. This was never generated via /create-app and isn't an Expo app, so url/apkUrl/iosResult are intentionally omitted rather than fabricated. status: succeeded reflects that the tool works and is in active use, not that it went through the generation pipeline.
